card.title: Be There for Me
card.instruction: Get someone to show up, help, or stay involved as proof that the connection still matters.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come paint the old kitchen with me. Since Dad died, I barely see you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll pay someone. I can't face painting over his height marks.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll keep them. Come help me tape around them.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll probably just sit on the floor and cry.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll sit with you. We can leave the paint unopened; I don't want us only meeting to empty his house.

mechanism: A seeks shared involvement in the old kitchen as proof of family connection and adapts the task to grief rather than substitutes paid labor.
confusable: Unlike seeking a completed paint job, A must preserve being together even if the work is not done.
comparison: D73-a accepts sitting and crying instead of painting; D73-b arranges a private pre-opening memory with Dad.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
